data.case_title: 1st Reminder (Mahnung) from TechMarkt Online for Invoice TM-2026-0048213
data.explanation: TechMarkt Online GmbH is reminding you that they have not received payment for invoice TM-2026-0048213, which was originally due on 03.09.2026. They have added a €5.00 reminder fee (Mahngebühr), bringing the total to €94.99. Pay this amount by the deadline shown using the IBAN and reference given. If you already paid, you can disregard this letter. If the payment does not arrive on time, the company says it will hand the debt over to a collection agency (Inkassodienstleister), which would add further costs. If you dispute the original invoice, contact TechMarkt Online's customer service directly.

items.title: Pay outstanding invoice plus reminder fee

items.consequence: Geht der Betrag nicht fristgerecht ein, müssen wir die Forderung an unseren Inkassodienstleister übergeben; dadurch entstehen Ihnen weitere Kosten.
